headline: Nashville turf temp of 157 F melts cleats, sends Sirianni for IV
summary: Players cleats were melting and head coach Nick Sirianni needed an IV as a result of extreme heat conditions at Nissan Stadium during Sunday's game between the Philadelphia Eagles and Tennessee Titans, a 24-20 Eagles win.

headline: QB Baker Mayfield says Bucs need to 'fight our way out' of 0-2 start
summary: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield admitted to being "pretty shocked" the Bucs are 0-2 for the first time since he has been their quarterback and the first time since 2014 after losing to his former team, the Browns, 23-19.

headline: Broncos Put Faith In OC Davis Webb
summary: After taking two years to put together a group he could weaponize in Denver, Broncos head coach Sean Payton finally fielded a top 10 offense in the NFL last year. headline: Brock Purdy keeps 49ers rolling with 'MVP' game vs. Dolphins
summary: Brock Purdy authored a near-perfect game at quarterback in the 49ers' 35-13 win over the rebuilding Dolphins, ending the day with a 99.7 QBR.

headline: Kirk Cousins' 'phenomenal' play has new-look Raiders at 2-0
summary: Kirk Cousins has done more than just help the Raiders transition through a rebuilding process after two games, leading Las Vegas to their first 2-0 record since 2021.

headline: Deshaun Watson makes case in Browns win with job on line
summary: With rumblings about his starting job being on the line, quarterback Deshaun Watson responded with maybe his best game as a Cleveland Brown.
